package.name: tracker
package.description:
Tracker ROS package — 目标检测与跟踪功能包。 从 PixEagle 提取核心跟踪算法，适配 PX4-Autopilot / Gazebo 接口， 提供归一化跟踪误差输出供下游 Follower 使用。
MRS-style ROS package for vision-based target detection and tracking. Extracts core tracking algorithms from PixEagle, adapts to PX4-Autopilot and Gazebo interfaces, and outputs normalized tracking errors for downstream Follower packages.
package.author: Tracker Team
